snippet.title: Fables of Dwale - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Forage, barter and explore a world that lives on after fairy tales end. Harvest fruits of the forest and engage with peculiar fairy folk and characters of folklore, as you uncover the secrets behind a dreadful illness that's fallen over the enchanted lands.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4235170/Fables_of_Dwale/
